body:
One error code covers two contradictory rules:

- PATCH /settings default_currency (accounts.py:141): must be a 3-letter uppercase ISO-4217 code.
- An expenses list's `currency` field (sync.py:876, :942, :502): free text, non-blank, at most 32 characters; the wire contract says it is deliberately not an ISO code ("EUR", "€", "pizza slices").

Both clients map invalid_currency to one string: "Enter a three-letter currency code, such as EUR" (web/src/i18n/apiErrors.ts, android ErrorText.kt, api_error_invalid_currency). A user whose expense-list currency is blank or over 32 characters is told the opposite of the rule.

Fix: a distinct code for the list currency (e.g. invalid_list_currency, or split blank vs too long), listed in docs/wire-contract.md's error table, mapped in both clients' error tables with a message that matches the rule, in all nine locales; crossClient.test.ts keeps them paired. Server test: the two rules produce two codes.
title: invalid_currency is one code for two contradictory rules; expense-list users are told to enter a 3-letter code
